g.text: 3 Average similarity using those positional weights
At each offset: mean similarity = Σ (pair weight × pair similarity) / Σ pair weight
This example: qokedy → qokeedy = 36.8 JS similarity points. At the marked offset, its weight share is 36.7%
of the 80 above-line pairs for this target; their weighted mean is 21.0. The published map pools all eligible targets.
From manuscript rectangles to a continuous similarity map
Illustration of the calculation, not a new result. Same-line pairs are calculated separately. Image: Yale, Beinecke MS 408, f75r.
